subject: CS364
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 videos. For English, all topics had multiple high-quality, highly relevant candidates, with selections from top academic and expert channels. For Arabic, coverage was good for most topics, though the selected video for 'The Due Diligence Process' covers it within the broader M&A context. No suitable Arabic video was found for 'Structuring the Deal' as all candidates failed relevance or view count gates.

coverage.note: Selected video covers due diligence as a key part of the broader M&A process, as no high-quality video focused solely on due diligence was available.
The only other candidate failed the view count gate.
All candidates failed hard gates, primarily for low relevance (not explaining asset vs. stock deals) or low view counts.

videos.title: Mergers and Acquisitions Due Diligence Explained
videos.filter_reason: A concise, highly relevant explanation of due diligence in M&A with a very high view count, indicating strong peer validation.

videos.title: Session 1: Introduction to Valuation
videos.filter_reason: This is the definitive introduction to valuation from Professor Aswath Damodaran, a leading academic authority on the subject, with massive reach.

videos.title: Discounted Cash Flow | DCF Model Step by Step Guide
videos.filter_reason: An excellent, practical step-by-step guide to building a DCF model that includes a downloadable Excel template, making it perfect for students.

videos.title: The Harvard Principles of Negotiation
videos.filter_reason: This video explains the foundational Harvard Principles of Negotiation, providing a robust, academic framework applicable to any deal, backed by millions of views.

videos.title: Asset vs. Share Purchase | How to Sell a Business, How to Buy a Business - David C. Barnett
videos.channel: David C Barnett Small Business and Deal Making SMB
videos.filter_reason: A clear explanation of asset vs. share purchases from a subject matter expert, with a high view count that far surpasses other eligible candidates.

videos.title: الاندماج والاستحواذ
videos.filter_reason: This is the best available option, providing a solid overview of the M&A process where due diligence is a key component, and it passes all hard gates.

videos.title: تقييم الشركات التقنية او عالية النمو (شركة جاهز كمثال)
videos.filter_reason: This video is perfectly tailored to the student audience, as it specifically explains how to value tech and high-growth companies using a real-world example.

videos.title: Business Valuation | DCF | Sensitive Analysis | Quick Review -  طريقة تقييم الشركات | تحليل الحساسية
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive tutorial that not only explains DCF but also includes a practical demo and sensitivity analysis, making it highly educational.

videos.title: أسرار التفاوض | ملخص الكتاب
videos.filter_reason: A high-quality, very popular book summary on negotiation from a well-regarded educational channel, making it the best choice among available options.
